gloss: quick pace; brisk walk; fast walking

definitions.gloss: quick pace; brisk walk; fast walking
definitions.explanation: Walking at a faster-than-normal pace. Not running, but walking with purpose and speed. Used both literally for the physical pace and figuratively for doing things hastily.

examples.japanese: {早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk at a brisk pace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧しそうな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I was about to be late, so I walked quickly toward the office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめなかった→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We rushed through the tourist spots, so we didn't really enjoy them.

notes:
Describes walking faster than usual, with purpose or urgency. Can also be used figuratively to describe rushing through an activity without taking time to appreciate it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk briskly
- {早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧: to walk past quickly
- {早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to rush through (a place)
- {早足|はやあし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to quicken one's pace

USAGE:
Usually used with the particle で as an adverbial expression. The figurative use ({早足|はやあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧, to rush through) implies that something was done too quickly and superficially.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小走|こばし}り→小走り：21117_kobashiri⟧: trot, light jog — faster than {早足|はやあし}; actually running with short steps
- ⟦{駆|か}け{足|あし}→駆け足：22316_kakeashi⟧: running, double-time — a full run
- ⟦{足早|あしばや}→足早：14454_ashibaya⟧: quick-footed — same meaning, different word order; slightly more literary
